title: a value-producing if expression requires an else branch
notes: specification/control-flow.mdx, 'If': 'An if expression MUST select exactly one reachable branch. When used where a value is required, every normal completion path MUST produce a compatible value.' The same section allows omitting the alternate 'only where the resulting unit or optional semantics are explicitly defined by the final grammar' — they are not, so the missing else has no defined value and specification/control-flow.mdx, 'Expression Forms', requires a statically determined type. 11-expression-if-switch/statement-if-is-not-reinterpreted-as-an-expression pins that the same shape stays legal in statement position.
